name: An idea

**What would you like it to do?**

**When would you use it?**

A concrete example helps more than a general description — what you'd
say or type, and what you'd expect back.

**Would it need the internet?**

Not a problem if so, but it changes how it has to be built and how it
has to be announced. Nearly everything here runs locally and the two
screens that don't say so on the page.
